name: Blinding Touch
body:
School necromancy; Level death mage 0, lathspell 0, shaman 0, sorcerer/wizard 0, witch 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a drop of citrus juice)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Fort negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You channel negative energy through your touch, blinding the target. You must succeed on a touch attack to strike a target. The subject is immediately blinded for the spell’s duration, though they get a new save each round at the end of their turn to end the effect..

This spell has no effect on a creature that is already blind or sightless.
